findings.description: Codex lane execution timed out during second-opinion check. The courier lane (gpt-5.6-terra on openai) did not complete within the execution window. This is a non-quota execution failure; no verdict of record was produced by the far side.
findings.evidence: codex exec timeout after 2 minutes on two attempted invocations with different prompt scopes. The lane is operational (errors visible) but execution did not complete.
